correctness.rationale: The explicit quadratic syzygy dLT-(ax-by)E and the connected linear automorphism argument show mdr=1 on the three coordinate lines and 2 otherwise. The two original base germs have Tjurina (k-1)(2k-1); the new transverse-base germ has local Tjurina 2k^2-2k+2 by the displayed all-k initial-ideal computation. Nodes and a single tangency tacnode yield the global Tjurina values, and Dimca's defect formula then gives 0/1/2. Independent symbolic Groebner checks at k=2..5 confirm local colength; k=3 has a redundant candidate leading term, not a contrary colength; finite checks do not replace the general standard-basis proof.
